## Use Space Mono in VS Code

Paste this into your settings to set Space Mono for the editor. The fallbacks are the same ones CodeFont writes.

{
  "editor.fontFamily": "'Space Mono', 'JetBrains Mono', 'SF Mono', Monaco, 'Cascadia Code', 'Roboto Mono', monospace"
}

## About the Space Mono coding font

A minimalist-style monospace font. Space Mono is a free monospace coding font without programming ligatures.

Space Mono is hosted on Google Fonts, so the specimen above renders without installing anything locally. It is one of the 95 families in the CodeFont catalog.

## Space Mono FAQ

### Is Space Mono free?

Yes. Space Mono is free to use; check the official source for the exact licence terms.

### Does Space Mono support ligatures?

No. Space Mono has no programming ligatures, so sequences such as -> and != are drawn as separate characters.

### Where can I get Space Mono?

Space Mono is available from Google Fonts and GitHub. The download links are listed in the Where to get section above.
